correctness.rationale: Re-executed inputs/artifacts/cubic_critical_loci.py and independently re-derived every essential identity in sympy: W0+6=S0^3/(xy), W1+6=S1^3/(xy^2(y+1)^2), W2+6=S2^3/(xy^2(x+1)^2(x+y+1)^2), and cancelled W3+6=S3^3/(x^3y^2(x+y)^2) with S3=x^2y+x^2+2xy+y^2 all match the DRAFT exactly (raw W3 pullback minus cancelled form simplifies to 0). Gradient numerators factor as S^2 times transverse factors in each case. Tracked Morse points (1,1)->(2,1)->(2,3)->(2,2) all satisfy gradient zero, value exactly 21, Hessian determinants 243, 243/4, 27/4, 243/16 (all nonzero, rechecked). Curve samples (1,-2), (1,-3/2+/-sqrt(5)/2), (1,-3+/-sqrt(5)), (2,-4+/-2sqrt(3)) all satisfy gradient zero, Hessian-determinant zero, value -6 (rechecked, including the W3 samples the script's degeneracy helper mislabels). Exhaustiveness of isolated critical points was verified beyond the script: W0 and W1 follow from linear/transverse factor solves, W2 from an exhaustive factor-pair solve (only (2,3) admissible, all other combos on S2=0 or poles), and W3-cancelled from Groebner/resultant solves (V&(x-y) gives only pole (0,0) and (2,2); V&U2 gives only (0,0)). The S=0-is-critical and Hessian-vanishes mechanism follows rigorously from dW=S^2(3M dS-S dM)/M^2, so Hessian entries carry an overall S factor. Pearl samples W0(1,1)=21 critical vs W0(-1,-1)=-7 with gradient (2,2) noncritical are correct. The headline as stated in research_report.json is bounded to the four examined potentials, and DRAFT section 5 honestly limits the arbitrary-depth extension to a mechanism-backed expectation, so the broader 'no torus in this class' sentence is properly qualified and does not falsify the proved headline.
